repositories.description: Vocat is an open-source web control panel and engineering toolkit for Quectel EC20/EC25-class cellular modems. It combines modem discovery, live radio status, AT and USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, proxy routing, notifications, audit logs, and release automation in one self-contained service.

GitHub-Actions-Basics-To-Production is a beginner-friendly repository for learning modern CI/CD and GitHub Actions from fundamentals to production workflows. It covers workflows, runners, automation concepts, and hands-on pipeline implementations through a structured progressive learning series.
